How many books have they read altogether?

parts.text: Rita hand-picks June worms from her plants every summer.
On Monday, she removed 39 June worms.
On both Tuesday and Wednesday, she removed twice as many June bugs as on Monday, and on Thursday she removed 48.
If the average number of June bugs removed each day from Monday to Friday is 60, then how many did Rita remove on Friday?

parts.text: A bakery produces 120 loaves of bread each day.
Two-thirds of the loaves are sold in the morning and half of what is left is sold equally in the afternoon and evening.
How many loaves of bread are sold in the afternoon?

parts.text: When the water is cold and the temperature is 10 degrees Celsius, Ray swims a mile in 16 minutes.
When the water is warm and the temperature rises to 25 degrees Celsius, Ray swims a mile in 2 minutes more than twice as long.

If Ray takes a 5-minute break after each mile when the water is warm, but these breaks do not count towards his total swimming time, how much longer does Ray take to swim 3 miles on a hot day than a cold day?
